contentText: Tech shares in Asia and Europe rebounded on Tuesday, following in the footsteps of Nvidia's shares closing on Wall Street 31 percent higher on Monday. The return of CEO Jensen Huang, 11 days after his resignation over an extramarital affair with an alleged Chinese spy, has reassured investors in the AI trade. In this edition, we look at Nvidia's central role in this trade, and Huang's central role at Nvidia. Also, French President Emmanuel Macron proposes to enshrine fiscal rules in the constitution.
